# SkyParkSecure Website
SkyParkSecure is an online comparison website for airport parking. Providing parking comparison across the UK to help people get the best rates possible. SkyParkSecure also provides comparisons for port parking, airport lounges and can also book fasttrack at some airport locations

## Products Sold
- [Airport Parking](https://www.skyparksecure.com/airport-parking): Book airport parking through SkyParkSecure
- [Hotels and Parking](https://www.skyparksecure.com/airport-hotels-with-parking): Combine a hotel stay with airport parking the night before you travel.
- [Airport Lounges](https://www.skyparksecure.com/airport-lounges): Add a bit of luxury by booking an airport lounge, whilst you wait for your flight.
- [Travel Money](https://www.skyparksecure.com/compare-travel-money): A quick and easy comparison service designed to help you find the best exchange rates by comparing the UK's top currency suppliers.

## Compare Parking with Confidence
- Price Check Promise: A hassle free way of comparing airport parking options. We guarantee to give you the lowest prices with our Price Check Promise; details can be found here: https://www.skyparksecure.com/skyparksecure-price-check-promise
- Safe & Secure Payments: Our payment system uses encryption to fully protect your details. We also offer PayPal as an additional payment option.
- Open Review Policy: Our review system collects honest feedback on every car park. We openly display the good & the bad reviews so that you can make the most informed decision.
- Over 3 Million Satisfied Customers: We pride ourselves on our outstanding customer service and we provide you with any help or advice you may need. You can drop us a message on our contact page (https://www.skyparksecure.com/contact-us)

## How to book with SkyParkSecure
Book easily in a few simple short steps
- Open the https://www.skyparksecure.com/ website
- Use the form at the top of the page and enter the following details: *Airport*: where your flight is from. *Drop off date and time*: when do you intend to park and leave your car. *Pick Up Date and Time*: when do you return to pick up your vehicle.
- Hit the search button
- Browse the parking options available. Take into consideration the pro’s and con’s of each parking option, such as: distance from your terminal, is there a shuttle service, is it a meet and greet product, etc.
- Once your choice is made, complete the booking via payment.
Once complete you will recieve email confirmation. You can now rest assured that your vehicle is safe whilst you focus on your holiday.
